description:
Random Assortment of Battlegroups

Download (File preview is missing, click File -> Download and it should work as normal)

Contents

Do you feel like the II, VI, IX, XVI, and XXVII Battlegroups are still not enough? Do you want more (poorly designed and colored) Battlegroups? Well my friend, you are in the right place! This mod currently adds 3 more battlegroups, only accessible to the players! (You gotta find the blueprints first...although some people might have those and are willing to nanoforge you some)

III Battlegroup, "Thunderbolt Spearheads"

They use rapid assault tactics, and are expert at closing distances (and overextend and die) to pressure enemies aggressively.

III Battlegroup ships get increased speed and flux capacity, but are poor at turning. 1.5x Cost.

Spoiler
Wolf (III)

No, this is not the Netherlands wolf, shut up about it!
Yes, this is an optionally ballistic wolf.

Manticore (III)

Slightly more firepower and mobility...but remember no more canister flak.

Falcon (III)

Ballistic and Composite Falcon (bring needlers and reapers!). Comes with free plasma burn too!

Dominator (III)

She's gonna ram you. I mean RAM you. You know that her name is Dominator, right?

VIII Battlegroup, "Thousand Cuts"

They use wolf pack tactics, usually beam-heavy support ships to make you keep your shield up, then its missiles in your ass.

VIII Battlegroup ships get increased PPT and Handling, but the bonus is rather small (Also they came in camo, in space. People are gonna think you are an idiot. 1.25x Cost.

Spoiler
Wolf (VIII)

Uh, yeah, it's a wolf. Honestly, not much more.

Tempest (VIII)

Imagine if Tempest gets even more expensive? But it comes with a built-in phase lance.
*wispers: and high energy focus!

Hyperion (VIII)

...NEW RECORD FOR THE MOST EXPENSIVE FRIGATE!

IV Battlegroup, "Iron Tempest"

They use saturation tactics with (mostly) HE/EMP medium and long-range missiles and fighters with longer range than usual.

IV Battlegroup ship can be fitted with missiles in all of its medium and large weapon slots. However, they get reduced OP (but if you mount ballistic weapons in the "extra" composite slot, you get them back). Their ship also get increase missile speed and range, as well as a massive armor bonus. However, the handling penalty is really high. 2x Cost.

Spoiler
Talon (IV)

It is basically a talon. But black.
Oh and you will get 6 pilot killed instead of 4

Trident (IV)

The pilots call these "quad-harpoon missile pod", and they're right.

Cerberus (IV)

A good missile battery needs some fodder...guess which ship is cheap and has the storage for a bit more fighters!

Mora (IV)

"Don't talk to me or my daughter ever again!" — Legion

Legion (IV)

Yes this is a Iron Warrior reference, how did you know?
P.S. For maximum funny, download a large harpoon mod so you can enjoy 60+ harpoons per wave!

I WANT BETTER MADE BATTLEGROUPS!!!

Change Logs

Spoiler
v1.3.1:  Added several paint job made by Morgan_Red21 (2026/5/10)
v1.3.0:  Added Cerberus (IV) and Talon (IV) (2026/5/9)
v1.2.2: Redone the III Battlegroup's color (2025/10/8)
v1.2.1: Add support for version checker (2025/9/2)
v1.2.0: Added Mora (IV) and Balance Change: (2025/8/23)
Spoiler
Trident (IV) Added Build-In Hullmod: Ill-advised Modification

v1.1.0: Added Legion (IV) and Trident (IV) (2025/7/30)
v1.0.0: Release (2025/7/11)
